observations: All 15 control rows (13 distinct control identities) passed: V1 code canary (hash match), V2 controls gate (15/15 PASS), V3 inventory gate (20/20 seeds HTTP 200).
Structural pass (Q1) completed for all 20 hosts. BFS budget 250, depth 6, item-blind FIFO in document order.
Q1 census: Only 1 of 15 engine classes (Sphinx-RTD) yielded DEEP (hop>=3) state-carrying items with controls_seen > 0: 32 items across 2 hosts (docs.readthedocs.io: 28, docs.pytest.org: 4).
14 engine classes have zero DEEP items with observed controls: Docusaurus, GNU-web, GitBook, GitHubDocs, Hugo, Hugo-k8s, Jekyll, MDN-Yari, MediaWiki, Sphinx, WordPress, custom, mdBook, phpBB.

Several engines have DEEP items in the structural graph (mdBook: 220 at hop 3; custom: 99 at hop 3-4; Sphinx: 9 at hop 3; Jekyll: 24 at hop 3; Docusaurus: 8 at hop 3) but all were unfetched (controls_seen=null) due to BFS budget exhaustion at 250 pages before reaching them.

Channel inventory: All 5 discovery channels live on >=1 host per DESIGN certificate. ON_SITE_SEARCH probeable on 10 hosts (search_form found). SITEMAP_XML on 9 hosts, ROBOTS_SITEMAP on 7, RSS_ATOM on 7, JSON_LD on 6.

Discovery stage (Q2/Q3) could not execute due to TypeError in frozen code: v.get('controls_seen', 0) > 0 fails when controls_seen is None (key exists with null value for unfetched pages). This is a defect in the frozen outcome-bearing code (prereg.md section 16).
Per decision rule G1: V1/V2/V3 all passed, but outcome stage code defect prevents measurement completion. Status=MEASUREMENT_INVALID, outcome=NOT_APPLICABLE.
validity_notes: VN-FROZEN-CODE-BUG: The frozen outcome-bearing module (prereg.md section 16, CODE_SHA256 75a01d490ec81609cbf87a606f8cfa9227d07f07765b2eb4fd876fef2c8ff53a) contains a bug at two locations (host_census computation and items list comprehension) where v.get('controls_seen', 0) > 0 raises TypeError because controls_seen is explicitly None for unfetched pages (key exists, value null). The .get() default is not used when key exists. This prevents discovery stage execution.

VN-BUDGET-LIMIT: BFS budget 250 is a hard cap enforced inside the link loop. For large sites (mdBook 220 DEEP items, custom 99, Sphinx-RTD 196 total), the budget is exhausted on shallow pages before DEEP pages are fetched and checked for controls. This means Q1 census of 'state-carrying DEEP items' only counts items that were both reached AND fetched within budget.

VN-UNIT-REDUCTION: Q1 state-carrying unit is page-level (>=1 named input/select), not the parent experiment's control-triple. Discovery channels resolve page URLs; charged costs are per page. Multi-control pages count once (conservative for item counts).

VN-REPRESENTATION: Body cap 600000 bytes (docs.gitbook.com seed truncated). Sitemap index -> FIRST child only. Robots.txt -> FIRST Sitemap: line only. Single discovery document fetch per channel per host.

VN-AMORTIZATION: Charged protocol costs use fresh-agent semantics (<=K=3). Actual discovery documents fetched once per (host, channel) at EXECUTE; item-page GET per item. Actual vs charged ledger not generated due to discovery stage failure.

VN-SEARCH-SEMANTICS: ON_SITE_SEARCH query = item slug (last path segment) via first GET form with named text-like input. Cross-host search actions (blog.wordpress.org -> wordpress.org) disclosed, not followed as membership shortcut.
VN-ENGINE-IDENTITY: engine_class from <meta name='generator'> when present, else DESIGN-recorded platform. 7 hosts had generator meta at DESIGN; 13 used documented platform.
VN-DRIFT: Live Web endpoints may change between freeze (2026-10-11T22:58:08Z) and EXECUTE. EXECUTE re-ran controls and inventory as gates; all passed.
